newsitem.title: BULGARIA: GERMANY'S DR OETKER MAY INVEST IN BULGARIA IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: GERMANY'S DR OETKER MAY INVEST IN BULGARIA IN 1997.

text.p: Germany's privately-owned food group Dr Oetker plans to launch joint production of deserts and baking ingredients in Bulgaria next year, a company official said on Wednesday.
"The strategic goal of Dr Oetker is to produce in Bulgaria the products which it now distributes here," Georgi Gramenov, executive director of Dr Oetker Bulgaria OOD, told a news conference.

Dr Oetker Bulgaria currently distributes products like instant desserts and baking additives in Bulgaria, but is negotiating with several local food manufacturers on the possibilities of setting up a joint venture next year, said Gramenov.
The company generated turnover of 100 million marks in eastern Europe in 1995 and it operates joint ventures in all other countries in the region.
Bulgaria, currently shaken by a grave economic crisis, has the lowest level of foreign investment in the region due to excessive red tape and inconsistantly applied legislation.
